pausedInfo: Paused: no new requests and no instant bookings. Existing confirmations remain valid.
activeInfo: Active: residents can send requests within your releases.
freeOnly: Without a payout account only €0 prices are possible. Connect your account under “Income & expenses”.
dailyZeroWarning: Note: a daily price of €0 caps every booking at €0.
priceRule: Calculation: daily price per full 24 h; for the rest, started hours × hourly price, at most one daily price.
accessNotesHint: Only visible to tenants, from confirmation until 7 days after the booking ends.
instant: Instant booking up to a duration of …
thresholdHint: Requests up to and including this duration are confirmed automatically (15 minutes to 365 days). You confirm longer requests yourself.
horizonTitle: Shorten the booking horizon for this spot
horizonHint: Leave empty to use the global value. You can only shorten, not extend.
tier1: Under 1 day: max. lead time in hours (max. {max})
tier2: 1 day to 1 week: lead time in days (max. {max})
tier3: From 1 week: lead time in months (max. {max})
rulesHint: Releases may reach further into the future than the booking horizon. Bookings are only possible within a release.
noRules: No releases yet – the spot cannot be booked.
blocksHint: Blocks take precedence over every release.
conflictIntro: This change collides with existing confirmations. They will be cancelled and refunded in full:
